design_philosophy.name: Italian Neo-Pop Utility
design_philosophy.description: A fusion of classic Italian graphic design (bold geometry, warm earth tones) with modern, high-speed utility. It prioritizes 'decision in 30 seconds' through high contrast, clear hierarchy, and energetic visuals.
core_principles: Speed over Decoration: Every element must aid the decision process.
Warmth over Tech: Use organic tones (Sand, Terracotta) instead of sterile grays.
Asymmetry creates Interest: Use the Bento grid to break visual monotony.
Map is Hero: The map is the primary interface; list view is secondary.

headings.usage: Use for all section titles, event names, and impact numbers.

body.usage: Use for descriptions, times, addresses, and UI labels.

mono.usage: Use for distance metrics (e.g., '1.2 km') and time tags.

colors.contrast_rules: Text must meet APCA standards. Use bold weights on colored backgrounds.

mobile.structure: Map as full-screen background. Floating Bottom Sheet for list/details.
mobile.navigation: Floating Pill Bar at bottom center (glassmorphism).

desktop.structure: Split View: Fixed Map on Right (50%), Scrollable Content on Left (50%).
desktop.grid: Bento Grid for Event List (mix of 1x1, 2x1, and 2x2 cards).

buttons.primary: rounded-full px-8 py-3 bg-primary text-white font-bold hover:scale-105 transition-transform shadow-lg
buttons.secondary: rounded-full px-6 py-2 border-2 border-primary/20 hover:border-primary text-primary font-medium

cards.event: bg-white dark:bg-zinc-900 rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:shadow-xl transition-all border border-black/5 overflow-hidden group
cards.category_pill: rounded-full px-3 py-1 text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-wider

map_markers.style: Custom CSS 'Squircle' or 'Lollipop'. Do not use default blue pin.

mock_data_structure.title: Aperitivo al Tramonto
mock_data_structure.description: Spritz and jazz on the rooftop.

visual_enhancers.gradients: No full gradients. Use gradients only for text clips or borders.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle noise overlay (opacity 0.03) to the main background to reduce digital sterility.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Leaflet with 'react-leaflet'. Ensure CSS is imported.
2. Implement the 'Squircle' marker using L.divIcon and Tailwind classes.
3. Use the defined color palette strictly. Do not deviate.
4. Ensure the 'Decide in 30s' goal is met by keeping the UI minimal and text large.
5. Use the provided Unsplash URLs for mock data images.
6. Make the map view the default for mobile, and split view for desktop.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover, press, load).
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable.
All interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes.
